info.name: ShikshaMitra - Tenant User Setup & UserScope Management
info.description:
Complete API collection for ShikshaMitra with proper tenant user authentication.

Workflow:
1. Use Host Admin Login ONLY for tenant creation
2. Use Tenant User Login (SSVM) for all other operations:
   - User Management
   - Role Creation & Assignment
   - UserScope Assignment
   - All tenant-specific operations

Tenant Info:
- Name: SSVM
- ID: 3a1dc7ba-395f-4af3-7ac7-ad923cc1f20e
- Admin Email: ssvm@gmail.com
- Admin Password: Temp@123

item.name: Authentication
Host Admin Login (For Tenant Creation Only)

exec: console.log('Host Admin token saved as admin_access_token');

request.description:
?? USE ONLY FOR TENANT CREATION ??

This is the host admin login. The token is saved as 'admin_access_token' and should ONLY be used for creating new tenants.

For all other operations (users, roles, scopes), use the 'Tenant User Login' instead.

exec: console.log('Tenant user token saved as access_token');
console.log('Use this token for all tenant operations!');

request.description:
? USE THIS FOR ALL TENANT OPERATIONS ?

Login as SSVM tenant admin user. This token (saved as 'access_token') should be used for:
- Creating users
- Assigning roles
- UserScope assignments
- All other tenant-specific operations

Credentials:
- Username: admin (or tenant-specific admin username)
- Password: Temp@123 (default from seeder)
- Tenant ID: 3a1dc7ba-395f-4af3-7ac7-ad923cc1f20e
